values.note: Seward County Ag Society: $30 a day (1 pm to 1 pm), 30-amp electric and dump station (in season) included; restrooms not included. Reservations paid 100% in advance; cancel at least 14 days ahead or lose the fee.

values.note: Reserve with the online or printable Camping Reservation Contract, 100% prepaid; site availability calendars on the page. Walk-ins pay by envelope (northwest pole of the picnic shelter, or the drop box on the west side of the Ag Pavilion). No long-term camping: call 402-646-0816 before planning more than 5 days.

note: RV campground at the Seward County Fairgrounds (1625 Fairgrounds Circle), run by the Seward County Ag Society, on grass northeast of the grandstand arena. No direct water hookups (a few hydrants); restrooms not included with a site. No generators, no ATVs; quiet hours 10 pm - 8 am. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Ag Society's page: $30/day, 30-amp, hydrants but no water hookups, dump (in season), reservable with full prepayment or walk-in envelope, no stays over 5 days without calling. Site count 39 -> 43 per the page. year_round true (derived) cleared: the page states no season. Note cleaned, including the past July 2026 tractor-pull closure.
flags: PIN (~400 m): stored 40.90890,-97.11180 is at the green-roofed building by the pond at the fairgrounds' south end (the dump station area). The page puts the 43 sites 'to the northeast of the grandstands' arena'; on imagery that's the grass field at ~40.9124,-97.1108. Suggest moving there. Moderate confidence: pedestals aren't visible at this resolution.

Open to the public: the page is written for any RV camper (reservations, walk-in envelopes, 'If you are in need of RV camping'), not just fair or event attendees. Fair-week and event closures aren't stated; the page's availability calendars didn't render in plain HTTP, so none were read. The old note's 'closed July 1-3, 2026 (Outlaw Tractor Pull)' is past and was dropped.
Ownership local stands: Seward County Ag Society (county agricultural society) runs it; the page doesn't say otherwise.
Max stay 5 is soft: 'If you plan to stay longer than 5 days please call... to discuss'. Kept 5 with that in booking.note.
Phone 402-646-0816 matches the page. Email ginny@sewardcountyfairgrounds.com.
Restrooms: 'Restroom availability is not included with campsite rentals'; no showers. Not waterfront confirmed: the only water is a small pond at the south end, far from the grass camp field.
